cases.title: Expand fixed tenant labels in one shop notice
cases.description: Six tenant-wide values reused across different notices. No per-customer values are in the map.
cases.origin: Project-authored deterministic workload model; not a production trace.
cases.contract: Exact case-sensitive bytes; no word-boundary rules, normalization, or case folding.

modes.label: Worker with the same dictionary already prepared

lifetime.pcre_note: Pattern keys can remain cached when only replacement values change; report warm and fresh-process compilation separately.

cases.str_replace_note: Longest-first sequential replacement agrees on all saved inputs; this is not a general equivalence.

documents.text:

expected.text:

Returns

documents.text:
Sold by {{company}}. Order history is available in your account.

Help and returns.

Help and returns.

documents.text: Delivery notice from {{brand}}: we send a tracking link after dispatch. Please keep the packaging until the contents have been checked. Help: {{help_url}}

expected.text: Delivery notice from Orchard Supplies: we send a tracking link after dispatch. Please keep the packaging until the contents have been checked. Help: https://help.example.test/

documents.text: Your feedback helps {{brand}} improve product instructions. Photos are optional. Do not include payment details in a public review. Contact {{support_email}} for private assistance.

expected.text: Your feedback helps Orchard Supplies improve product instructions. Photos are optional. Do not include payment details in a public review. Contact help@example.test for private assistance.

documents.text: The current shop operator is {{company}}. For delivery questions use {{support_email}}. Existing orders remain visible at {{account_url}}.

expected.text: The current shop operator is Orchard Retail Ltd. For delivery questions use help@example.test. Existing orders remain visible at https://shop.example.test/account.

documents.text: Thank you for choosing {{brand}}. If an item needs to be exchanged, read the instructions at {{returns_url}} before sending the parcel. {{company}}

expected.text: Thank you for choosing Orchard Supplies. If an item needs to be exchanged, read the instructions at https://shop.example.test/returns before sending the parcel. Orchard Retail Ltd
